name: Adagrasib
mechanism: Covalent, irreversible inhibitor of KRAS G12C binding the switch-II pocket in the GDP-bound state; designed for a long half-life and sustained target inhibition, with CNS penetration.
interactions: Adagrasib is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and also inhibits CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and P-gp; review co-medications carefully. Avoid other QT-prolonging drugs where possible.
resistance: Similar to sotorasib: secondary KRAS mutations, amplification of KRAS G12C, and bypass MAPK/RTK activation.
